day.headline: A Ox day — Snake and Rooster are in step.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: This week broke pattern. Ride it into something bigger today.

reasons: Snake and Ox share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: something opened for the first time
signs.message: First time through that door today. Walk in slow, look around.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You chose the long way on purpose. Choose it again.

reasons: Rooster and Ox share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: being bored in a good way
signs.message: Bored and fine with it. Follow that into something new.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: an exception that became the rule
signs.message: Your one-time exception is just how you do it now. Own it.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: The week blurred past. Salvage one small thing before dark.

reasons: Ox's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: a sleep you will not get back
signs.message: You lost four hours last night. Coast, don't catch up.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: That wrong exit found you a better block. Note it down.

reasons: Rat pairs with Ox — a harmonious day
signs.message: You prepped a whole speech nobody asked for. Shelve it.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You handled one thing well. That's the whole quota, rest.

reasons: Goat opposes Ox — a day to take slowly
signs.message: You left that conversation clumsily. It can stay unmended today.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: No plans tonight and no guilt about it. Enjoy that.
